$sources: NBCC 2020 4.1.7.3 (static procedure): p = Iw q Ce Ct Cg Cp; Ce of open and rough terrain, Cg = 2.0 for the building as a whole, Cp of the walls by H/D
source: NBCC 2020 4.1.7.3 static procedure (the power law of the program with V of the town's q1/50; the cladding, internal pressure and roof coefficients the parent's ASCE 7-22 / BNBC values until checked)

open.description: Open terrain: level terrain with only scattered buildings, trees or other obstructions, open water or shorelines

rough.description: Rough terrain: suburban, urban or wooded terrain extending upwind (at least 1 km or 20 times the building height)

sources.exposures: NBCC 2020 4.1.7.3(5): Ce = (h/10)^0.2 >= 0.9 (open terrain) and 0.7 (h/12)^0.3 >= 0.7 (rough terrain), written as Kz = kzFactor (max(z, kzMinHeight)/zg)^(2/α): open α 10, zg 10 m, factor 1.0, least height 5.905 m (Ce 0.9); rough α 6.667 (2/α = 0.3), zg 12 m, factor 0.7, least height 12 m
sources.topographic: Ct = 1.0 (flat terrain); NBCC 4.1.7.4 speed-up over hills is not covered (topography: none)
sources.gust: NBCC 2020 4.1.7.3(8): Cg = 2.0 for the building as a whole and its main structural members (static procedure)
sources.cpByHeight: NBCC 2020 4.1.7.3 and its commentary for the static procedure: Cp windward 0.8, leeward -0.5 for H/D >= 1; 0.6 and -0.3 for H/D < 0.25; linear between (taken at the top of each band, on the safe side); w the lesser plan dimension; leeward Ce at the roof height h (NBCC takes it at h/2: on the safe side)
